svg.title: Diagnostic: a day on the vans and a day in the office
svg.text: 05 · THE AUDIT: TWO DAYS ON SITE
Two C2s found; the quote now
No job number given: the bill
50 min typing after the last job
22 CEF lines matched to jobs by
The office line now rings out
